decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The brickwork of the extension shall match the existing brickwork of the house.
description: Demolition and reconstruction of existing side conservatory, erection of single storey rear extension, conversion of existing garage to utility room and internal alterations to dwellinghouse
